t: The Power Port allows you to provide the energy needed to power the Fluidizer.$(br2)Any Forge Energy-compatible cable or generator can be connected to the Power Port.
能量端口可以为流化器提供运行所需的能量。$(br2)任何兼容 Forge 能量的线缆或发电机都可以连接到能量端口。
$(l)Mandatory:$() at least one is required$(br)$(l)Valid positions:$() any face (not on frame)$(br)$(l)Graphical interface:$() no
$(l)必需：$()至少需要一个$(br)$(l)有效位置：$()任意面上（不在框架上）$(br)$(l)图形界面：$()否
